US Senate Considers Ambassador Nominee to Barbados

The U.S. Senate is considering the nomination of Kimberly Greenwood to serve as the ambassador to Barbados. Greenwood is the wife of Lee Greenwood, a singer known for the song "God Bless the USA." The Trump administration submitted her name, along with other nominees, to the Senate for confirmation. The nomination is proceeding through the Senate's confirmation process.
